descriptionChirho: The olive tree (Olea europaea) as a cultivated plant, including singular and plural references, possessive forms, agricultural contexts, orchards/groves, and figurative comparisons to an olive tree.
The olive as a fruit or agricultural product, distinguished in some target languages (e.g., Spanish 'aceituna' vs 'olivo') from the tree itself.
The word as used in the toponym 'Mount of Olives' (har ha-zetim), a well-known hill east of Jerusalem, where the plural form functions as part of a proper place name.
